title: Texas Cop Detains Runaway Goat on Busy Road
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Little Elm, Texas — On November 25, 2025, a Little Elm Police Officer spotted a goat roaming along the edge of a busy roadway, apparently after escaping its enclosure. Concerned that the animal could be hit by a passing car, the officer pulled over to guide it out of danger. As he approached, the goat stayed surprisingly calm, allowing the officer to coax it toward his patrol vehicle. Once the goat climbed into the back seat, the situation turned humorous, the officer jokingly “read it its rights,” treating the encounter like a playful mock arrest. The light-hearted exchange was captured on bodycam, and after ensuring the goat was safe, the officer contacted the owner to come retrieve it.
